name: Mishika (Mišika)
behavior: sits or idles at a hiding spot. The first time Mita comes within ~64px, play hide and teleport her to the next spot (2 spots before she stays). The third time, play found and attach her to Mita (carry animations).

hide.notes: frames 2-3 are clipped on the right: line frame x=22 (frame 2) and x=16 (frame 3) up with the left edge of the box she hides behind; then move her to the next hiding spot

found.notes: meows on frames 0-1, crouches, leaps toward Mita on frame 3; then switch Mita to carry
